title: Thread panel
responsibility: Coordinates an entity conversation, comments, agent requests, selected design and approval controls.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.entity
inputs.description: Required current entity with versions, history, threads, category and latest version. Supplies identity for comments and requests. Function comments default to the function rather than an old image.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace held by the run and comment stores for this view. Supplies bridge, revision, context and capabilities, which determine offered modes and approval controls. Loads comments/providers and subscribes to run events on mount.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.thread
inputs.description: Optional bindable current thread, initially null. Takes precedence over target and design when choosing the conversation anchor. Selecting/opening a thread updates it; a thread on another option of the same version is cleared when that option changes.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.target
inputs.description: Optional bindable image or region awaiting a thread, initially null. Used when no thread is selected. Cleared on thread selection or creation and when it belongs to a different option of the shown version.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.version
inputs.description: Optional bindable version, initially empty. Chooses design and approval context; history selection updates it. A handled run event may advance it to the entity latest version.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.option
inputs.description: Optional bindable current design option, empty by default. Determines approval and image target. Selecting a same-version thread can adopt its option.

inputs.name: ThreadPanel.close
inputs.description: Required callback for closing the conversation; invoked by its close button.

outputs.name: ThreadPanel
outputs.description: Conversation sidebar with history, grouped threads, saved/pending messages, streaming response, status/cancel, errors and a composer. Plan/Change opens a planning thread when necessary; Change includes recorded approval details. Human comments use the comments store without starting an agent. Shared comment success refreshes and selects the saved thread. Approval appears only for a selected design with approval capability.
